headline: EBRD grants $100 million credit line to National Bank of Egypt for microenterprises
summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development provided a $100 million financing facility to the National Bank of Egypt to expand microfinance availability across the private sector.
why: National Bank of Egypt is the country's largest commercial lender. EBRD credit lines expand liquidity for small businesses in developing markets.

impacts.name: National Bank of Egypt
impacts.why: The $100 million EBRD facility boosts the bank's lending liquidity for microenterprises.
